svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One print: a 194 mm round plate 3 mm thick, a box wall 3 mm thick

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 35 mm tall round its edge (188 mm inside), and the dome

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shape standing on the plate in the middle, crown up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dome shape: 150 mm across at the plate, 104 mm across the crown,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 22 mm tall, 6 mm radius round the crown edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print with the plate on the bed; 4 walls; 20 % infill is enough.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sand the dome shape smooth (to 400 grit) and seal it with primer:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the silicone copies every layer line onto the dome.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal the joint between plate and wall with a bead of hot glue.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Use: spray mould release, pour silicone to 10 mm over the crown

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (32 mm deep), let it cure, then pull the block out (step 1).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plate sits flat; no gap at the foot of the dome.
